name: Manage Service
description: Starts, stops, reloads or restarts a service, or sets whether it starts at boot.

parameters.name: action
parameters.label: Action

options.label: Reload
options.help: Reloads it every time this block runs — put it behind a "repaired" arrow (e.g. after Render Template) or a condition.

options.label: Restart
options.help: Restarts it every time this block runs — put it behind a "repaired" arrow (e.g. after Render Template) or a condition.

parameters.help: Reload and Restart act every time this block runs: connect them with a "repaired" arrow so they only run after a change.
